EXPLANATORY HANDBOOK to

2.1.2 Structural Survey
(A) Record Drawings
The presence of WBW should be identified and recorded.

(B} Survey items
Apart from the items described in the Code, the following should also be covered:
(12) The presence of chimneys with or without supperting frames, and external frames
supporting air conditioners or cooling towers in industrial and commercial buildings,

(13) The presence of UBW should be surveyed and checked for structural stability. A method
statement for removal of the illegal structure should be prepared and accompanied with
the submission.

(14) Special architectural features, if any.

Special Structures

(5) Chimneys with or without supporting frames, and external frames supporting alr
conditioners or cooling towers, particularly in industrial and commercial buildings, should
be identified and included in the survey.
